## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The README still says the default timeout is 30 seconds, which contradicts the new 60-second default and should be fixed. The code change itself is correct: `test_defaults` and `test_explicit_options` exercise both the new default and the explicit override, though this review read these tests and did not run them.

## Changes
The pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README.md:3 to state the 60-second default — When you run the CLI without `--timeout`, it now waits 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users who rely on the README expect requests to fail after 30 seconds and will misread waits that now last up to 60 seconds. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
